title: Bounded interactive Multi-Site health writes
opportunity: Manual Health history persistence and alert acknowledgement writes passed the request token directly to PostgreSQL without an explicit write budget.
rootCause: A slow transaction could leave an interactive Health action waiting or surface an uncategorized cancellation even though the read and mutation-lock phases already had bounded policies.
implementation: Added a two-second linked SiteHealthWriteBudget with explicit client-cancellation distinction.
Applied it to manual health history persistence and to acknowledgement persistence after the existing mutation lock is acquired.
Returned site_health_write_timeout for acknowledgement write expiry, while manual probe responses safely report historyPersisted=false when history persistence times out.
Added localized Thai recovery copy for the new API problem code.

tdd.red: SiteHealthWriteBudgetTests initially failed to compile because the write budget policy did not exist; the endpoint contract then failed until both write paths were bounded.

verification.impeccableDetector: 0 anti-patterns; four pre-existing advisory design-system-color findings in app.js (#ff4d5e, #22374f, #ff6378); no new finding

boundaries: Live PostgreSQL slow-write execution, authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, visual responsive verification, full VSTest testhost connectivity, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain unverified.
